model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of completions and coverage for four different models. The y-axis, labeled "Coverage", has a linear scale with a value range of 0.4 to 0.9 and is not explicitly unitized; tick labels are regularly spaced at intervals of 0.1, starting from 0.4 and increasing to 0.9. The x-axis, labeled "Number of completions (k)", has a logarithmic scale with a value range of 2^0 to 2^8; tick labels are regularly spaced at intervals of 1, starting from 0 and increasing to 8, representing powers of 2. The plot contains four lines: a blue line with circular markers and a solid style representing Llama-3B, a green line with triangular markers and a solid style representing Llama-3B + FT, a light blue line with circular markers and a dashed style representing Llama-1B, and a light green line with triangular markers and a dashed style representing Llama-1B + FT. The blue line starts at approximately 0.45 at 2^0 and increases steadily to around 0.85 at 2^8. The green line starts at approximately 0.45 at 2^0 and increases steadily to around 0.88 at 2^8. The light blue line starts at approximately 0.42 at 2^0 and increases steadily to around 0.78 at 2^8. The light green line starts at approximately 0.42 at 2^0 and increases steadily to around 0.86 at 2^8.
